audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Tryndamere levels 3 and 4 and gave Mel level 6, which contradicts the already-audited mirror (audits/top/mel__tryndamere) and bounces non-monotonically.
audit.why: Tryndamere has no gap-closer until 3 and Spinning Slash is 650 range against Solar Snare at 1000 range; Mel owns levels 1-3. Level 6 gives Tryndamere Undying Rage, so it cannot be Mel's level.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Mel, Mel, Mel, Skill, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere with ratings 3,3,4,5,5,6,7 — the exact inverse of the mirror's 7,7,6,5,5,4,3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named Mel's ultimate 'Solar Snuffer', a fabricated name, and treated level 3-4 as a Tryndamere power window.
audit.why: Riot's kit lists R as Golden Eclipse (120/100/80s, 25000 range, scales with Overwhelm stacks). Tryndamere's real spikes are 6 (Undying Rage) and first item.
audit.corrected: Golden Eclipse used throughout with its real cooldown; the free window moved to level 6 and first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rebuttal (W) was described only as a reflect, so the page implied autos still land. Mocking Shout's slow condition was never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: Rebuttal 'prevents her from taking damage' as well as reflecting projectiles, on a 38/35/33/29/26s cooldown — a full damage-immunity window, the single biggest reason a dive fails. Mocking Shout only slows enemies with their backs turned, making it a chase tool, not an opener.
audit.corrected: Both stated in spikes[0], mid, late and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Mel's combo opens with a Searing Brilliance auto-attack reset, or that Tryndamere has no dash to escape a cut retreat.
audit.why: listed in missingInteractions for this matchup
audit.corrected: Recorded in notes; the auto-reset tell is folded into spikes[0] framing.

edits.before: E lets you spin in and out of exchanges on your terms. Only take the trade when Mel's Solar Snare is down.
edits.after: You have no dash until 3, so Solar Snare at 1000 range and Radiant Volley own level 2. Farm it out, don't contest.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mel must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Spinning Slash is online at 650 range, but she still edges it — hold E to dodge Solar Snare, not to open the trade.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Solar Snare's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even now: trade only while Solar Snare is down for its 9-11s, and never dive into Rebuttal — it prevents damage outright.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mel's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds, so all-ins go live — but Golden Eclipse reaches you anywhere, so pop R before the strike lands, never after.

edits.before: Level 2 stays skill-based as neither champion has a committing all-in yet.
edits.after: Level 2 is hers — Radiant Volley and Solar Snare outrange you with no E yet.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: with E online you dictate the gap when her W reflect is down.
edits.after: Level 3 she still edges it — Spinning Slash is up but Solar Snare roots you flat.

edits.before: Level 4 stays yours — your Q-reset dive shreds her squishy body inside the reflect window.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are skill — dodge Solar Snare and your dive shreds her; eat it and you die.

edits.before: Level 5 is even because her R and full poke kit give her a punish on a mistimed dive.
edits.after: Level 5 stays even — Golden Eclipse punishes a mistimed dive until 6 hands you Undying Rage.

edits.before: Mel wants to poke with Radiant Volley (Q) and zone you with her Rebuttal (W) reflect; bait the W, then E in on the window where her reflect is down and burn Q resets.
edits.after: Mel pokes with Radiant Volley (Q) and Rebuttal (W) prevents damage outright, not just reflects; bait it, then E in during its 38s rank-1 downtime and Bloodlust the poke off.

edits.before: Her R Solar Snuffer is a lane-wide burst-and-execute, but you have R Undying Rage — pop it before her ult finishes and Q Bloodlust back to full while she's committed.
edits.after: Her R Golden Eclipse strikes you at any range, scaling with Overwhelm stacks — pop Undying Rage before it lands and Bloodlust back to full on its 120/100/80s cooldown.

edits.before: You take control levels 3-4: once Spinning Slash (E) is online you pick the window her Rebuttal (W) reflect is down and dive her squishy body with Q Bloodlust resets. Level 5 is even because her full poke kit and W can punish a mistimed all-in, so bait the reflect first.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are close: Spinning Slash (E) is online at 650 range, but dive only while Rebuttal (W) sits on its 38/35/33/29/26s cooldown — it prevents damage outright. Mocking Shout only slows her once her back is turned, so it is a chase tool, never your opener.

edits.before: With R Undying Rage and a lifesteal item you overwhelm her — her burst and R Solar Snuffer can't kill through your ult, and your Q out-sustains her magic poke. Split the sidelane; a control mage has no answer to a fed diver on her.
edits.after: With R Undying Rage and a lifesteal item you overwhelm her — Golden Eclipse cannot kill through your 5-second ult, and Bloodlust out-sustains her poke. Split the sidelane; Rebuttal blanks damage, but only for the seconds it is up.

notes: Mel is female; the page used 'him/he' throughout — fixed where the length band allowed. Kit flag misfire confirmed with the mirror: tryndamere.json tags Mocking Shout (W) as 'projectile', but Riot's description is a point-blank insulting cry, so no Rebuttal-reflect claim was made in either direction. Two missing interactions recorded but not forced into prose: (1) Mel's combo opens with a Searing Brilliance auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell; (2) Rebuttal creates a barrier that can cut a retreat and Tryndamere has no dash out, so Flash is for the wall, not the damage.
